title: Party Tableware Set for 16 Guests, Paper Plates, Cups, Napkins and Wooden Cutlery
description:
Everything you need to lay a colourful birthday table in one box, made from paper and wood instead of single-use plastic.
• Contents: 16 large plates (23 cm), 16 dessert plates (18 cm), 16 cups (250 ml) and 32 napkins
• Also includes 16 sets of wooden forks, knives and spoons
• Bright polka-dot and confetti designs
• Paper items are compostable after use

title: Birthday Cake Candles Set, Happy Birthday Letters and 24 Spiral Candles
description:
Colourful candles that spell out the birthday message, plus a pack of slim spiral candles for cupcakes and cakes.
• Contents: 13 letter candles spelling HAPPY BIRTHDAY and 24 spiral candles (6 cm) in assorted colours
• Includes 12 plastic holders for the spiral candles
• Burn time approx. 8–10 minutes
• Never leave burning candles unattended; keep away from children and flammable materials

title: Happy Birthday Party Hats, 12 Pieces with Gold Foil Lettering
description:
Classic cone party hats in white card with shiny gold lettering and stars, for birthday parties of all ages.
• Contents: 12 cone hats, approx. 16 cm tall and 11 cm in diameter
• Sturdy card with gold foil print
• Soft elastic chin strap on every hat
• Supplied flat; quick to assemble with the pre-attached tab

title: Latex Party Balloons 12 Inch, Pack of 100 in Assorted Colours
description:
Thick, glossy latex balloons for birthdays, baby showers and classroom parties. Fill with air for floor and garland displays or with helium to float.
• Contents: 100 balloons, 12 in (30 cm) when inflated
• Natural latex, approx. 2.8 g each for good durability
• Choose from three colour mixes
• Floats for about 8–12 hours when filled with helium (helium not included)
• Warning: children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or broken balloons. Adult supervision required

title: Balloon Garland Arch Kit, 120 Balloons with Decorating Strip and Glue Dots
description:
Build an eye-catching balloon arch for a party backdrop, entrance or dessert table. The kit includes balloons in several sizes and all the tools to assemble it.
• Contents: 120 latex balloons in 5 in, 10 in, 12 in and 18 in sizes
• Includes a 5 m decorating strip, 100 glue dots, tying tool and ribbon
• Makes a garland of approx. 4–5 m
• Hand pump included; an electric pump (not included) makes inflating quicker
• Warning: children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or broken balloons. Adult supervision required

title: 2027 New Year Foil Balloons, 4 Giant 40 Inch Numbers
description:
Ring in the new year with giant metallic numbers that make a striking backdrop for New Year's Eve parties and photos.
• Contents: 4 foil number balloons (2, 0, 2 and 7), each approx. 40 in (100 cm) tall
• Self-sealing valve; fill with air or helium (helium not included)
• Includes a straw for air filling and 5 m of ribbon
• Reusable: deflate carefully and store flat
• Warning: children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or broken balloons. Adult supervision required

title: Masquerade Mask Set for Couples, Lace-Cut Silver and Black Masks
description:
A matching pair of Venetian-style masks for masked balls, carnival, themed weddings and New Year's Eve parties.
• Contents: 1 silver mask with rhinestones and 1 black mask with filigree pattern
• Lightweight metal-look plastic, approx. 18 x 8 cm
• Satin ribbon ties to fit most adults
• Soft padding at the nose bridge for comfort

title: Classic Witch Hat with Wide Brim, Black Felt for Adults and Kids
description:
A pointed witch hat with a crooked tip and wide brim that completes any Halloween, carnival or storybook costume.
• Material: soft polyester felt with a wire-shaped brim
• Height approx. 38 cm, brim diameter approx. 40 cm
• Available in adult (58 cm head) and kids (52 cm head) sizes
• Keep away from fire and heat sources

title: Kids' Bat Wings Costume with Elastic Arm Loops and Ears Headband
description:
Flappy black bat wings that slip on in seconds over everyday clothes, for Halloween, dress-up days and themed parties.
• Includes: bat wings (approx. 100 cm wingspan) and a headband with bat ears
• Soft satin-feel polyester with stitched wing ribs
• Elastic shoulder straps and wrist loops so the wings open when arms are raised
• Sizes: 3–5 years and 6–8 years. Keep away from fire and heat sources

title: Happy Birthday Banner and Gold Foil Curtain Backdrop Set
description:
Turn any wall into a party backdrop with a letter banner and shimmering foil curtains, ready to hang in minutes.
• Includes: HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting banner (approx. 3 m) and 2 foil fringe curtains (1 x 2.5 m each)
• Also includes 10 gold latex balloons, ribbon and adhesive dots
• Card letters with glitter finish, pre-strung on twine
• Reusable for future parties
• Warning: children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or broken balloons. Adult supervision required

title: Fabric Bunting Flags 10 m, 30 Triangle Pennants in Bright Colours
description:
Cheerful triangle bunting for garden parties, birthdays, school fairs and summer celebrations, indoors or outdoors.
• Length: 10 m with 30 flags, each approx. 20 x 28 cm
• Water-resistant polyester fabric, colours will not run in the rain
• Flags stitched onto a sturdy cotton tape with loops at both ends
• Machine-washable at 30 °C

title: Round Paper Lanterns, Set of 10 in 3 Sizes, 20–30 cm
description:
Paper lanterns that add instant colour to birthdays, weddings, baby showers and garden parties. Hang them from the ceiling, a tree or along a string.
• Contents: 10 lanterns (4 x 30 cm, 3 x 25 cm and 3 x 20 cm)
• Choose pink and purple shades or classic white
• Thin paper with a wire expander inside; opens in seconds and folds flat for storage
• For decoration only: never use with candles or other open flames (battery LED lights are fine)

title: Kraft Wrapping Paper Roll 70 cm x 10 m with White Polka Dots
description:
Sturdy brown kraft paper with a simple dot print, a timeless choice for birthdays, Christmas and everyday gifts. Add ribbon or twine for a natural look.
• Size: 70 cm x 10 m on a cardboard core
• 80 gsm recyclable kraft paper
• White dots printed on one side; plain kraft on the reverse
• Easy to cut, fold and tape without tearing

title: Paper Gift Bags with Handles, 12 Assorted Sizes and Tissue Paper
description:
A set of patterned gift bags in three sizes so you always have the right bag ready, with tissue paper to fill them.
• Contents: 4 small (18 x 10 x 23 cm), 4 medium (26 x 12 x 32 cm) and 4 large (32 x 12 x 42 cm) bags
• Includes 12 sheets of tissue paper and 12 gift tags
• 200 gsm paper with twisted paper handles
• Assorted grid, stripe and plain designs

title: Gift Ribbon Set, 6 Rolls of Satin and Velvet Ribbon, 5 m Each
description:
Soft satin and velvet ribbons for tying bows on presents, bouquets and hampers, and for festive crafts.
• Contents: 6 rolls x 5 m in red, green, blush pink, ivory, gold and navy
• Widths: 3 rolls of 25 mm satin and 3 rolls of 15 mm velvet
• Wound on wooden-look spools that keep ribbon neat
• Polyester; ends can be heat-sealed to prevent fraying

title: Swinging Balls Desk Toy with 5 Chrome Balls and Wooden Base
description:
The classic Newton's cradle: lift one ball, let go and watch the momentum click back and forth. A satisfying gift for offices, teachers and science fans.
• 5 chrome-plated steel balls (20 mm) on adjustable nylon strings
• Gold-tone metal frame on a solid wood base
• Size approx. 18 x 9 x 12 cm
• Decorative item for adults; not a toy, keep away from children under 14 years

title: Hourglass Sand Timer, 30 Minutes, Decorative Desk Ornament
description:
A handsome hourglass for timing focus sessions, board games or tea breaks, and a calming piece of décor on a desk or bookshelf.
• Runs for approx. 30 minutes
• Clear borosilicate glass filled with fine sand
• Choose a turned wooden frame (approx. 18 cm tall) or a frameless glass version (approx. 15 cm tall)
• Comes in a gift box

title: Shatterproof Christmas Baubles, 24 Pieces in Matte, Glitter and Shiny Finishes
description:
A coordinated set of Christmas tree baubles that will not break if they fall, so they are safe around pets and children.
• Contents: 24 baubles, 6 cm diameter, in matte, glitter and shiny finishes
• Shatterproof plastic with pre-attached hanging string
• Choose from two colour themes
• Stored in a reusable box with dividers

title: Knitted Christmas Stocking 45 cm with Snowflake Pattern and Plush Cuff
description:
A cosy cable-knit stocking to hang by the fireplace or on the door, ready to be filled with small gifts and sweets.
• Size: approx. 45 cm long, 20 cm wide at the cuff
• Soft acrylic knit with a white plush cuff and snowflake detail
• Hanging loop sewn into the cuff
• Hand-wash cold and dry flat

title: Halloween Pumpkin String Lights, 3 m with 20 LEDs, Battery Operated
description:
Smiling jack-o'-lantern lights that bring a warm orange glow to windows, mantels, porches and Halloween parties.
• Length: 3 m with 20 pumpkin-shaped LEDs, plus 30 cm lead
• Powered by 2 x AA batteries (not included); battery box with on/off switch
• Steady and flashing modes
• Suitable for indoor use and covered outdoor areas (IP44 battery box)
